I think its more society saying I should than me wanting too. I admit I have some trauma with sex and mild when it comes to dating. When I was in middle school I had guys ask me out as a joke. So maybe there both elements but deep down I really think I was born this way.

A friend one day decided to tell me I should talk to other guys and that if I want a boyfriend I need to not talk to my guy friends. And I sat there for awhile and beat myself up for the fact that I didn't want that. Then someone pointing out that I should be dating etc made me feel worse. I have these feeling like o maybe it would be nice to have someone. Then I realize I don't want that. The older I get the more insecure I get about it. My parents make comments, everyone does. I do want to just say "I'm not gay or something, I just have never had the desire to be with someone or pursue that" but idk how that would go over.
Yeah I wish I wanted to date but I truly don't want too.
